mechanism.claim: During elevated completed realized variation, a sign flip in the canonical three-period Time Series Forecast's one-step-ahead displacement identifies a new local linear trend direction. Follow the forecast direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when forecast-minus-current close flips strictly from negative to positive; short on the strict reverse
mechanism.why_distinct: Regression Channel uses fitted bands and breakouts; moving-average candidates compare price with smoothed levels or line slopes. HVTSF3 extrapolates a least-squares line one full step beyond the current three-bar window and trades only strict sign flips of that forecast displacement. It uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the forecast transition is admitted only when trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour extrapolated forecast-direction flips are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.forecast: LEAN TimeSeriesForecast(3) over completed closes, reset across gaps
features.displacement: forecast-current completed close, finite strict nonzero
features.flip: current displacement strict sign differs from immediately prior source-valid strict nonzero displacement
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over trailing completed twenty-four hours), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: forecast window, prior sign, variation window, and rank history reset after any invalid four-hour bar

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official documented three-period one-step forecast under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no forecast period, formula, side, variation, hold, clock, subset, threshold, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: QuantConnect LEAN TimeSeriesForecast canonical implementation derived from Tulip Indicators
external_basis.fixed_definition: ordinary least-squares fit to x=1..3 completed closes, forecast=a+b*4; displacement=forecast-current close
external_basis.selection_use: official documented example period 3 and exact forecast formula only; sign-flip trading application is untested; no incidence or outcomes
